what: An .mxf output whose sound was re-encoded failed: decision.audio_codec_for() had no entry for it, so cut.py's --accurate/--remove/--segments paths and 24 other tools' re-encodes chose AAC, and the MXF muxer's pcm_rechunk refused the header, so nothing was written.
escaped: The codec choice was read only from the audio-only extensions (AUDIO_CODECS), and every other output extension fell back to AAC; no test cut into an .mxf output and the container's PCM-only constraint was not represented anywhere.
mechanism: decision.CONTAINER_AUDIO_CODECS maps the output extension to the one codec its muxer takes, and audio_codec_for() is the single place a writing tool names its sound codec (the 27 hard-coded aac_args() call sites now pass the output path). tests/test_contract.py's MxfAudioCodec736Tests scans every script for a hard-coded aac_args() and pins .mxf to PCM; test_cut_copy.py cuts an MXF into an .mxf output and reads the codec back.
